faq.q1: Where do the tastings take place?
faq.a1: The tours and tastings take place right inside our Frantoio del Pasqua, located in Loc. Infernaccio 510/B, Monte San Savino (in the province of Arezzo). You will discover how our oil is produced while surrounded by the extraction machinery.
faq.q2: What does the analysis in the mill consist of?
faq.a2: We will guide you in discovering our cultivars. You will learn to recognize the fruity, bitter, and spicy notes that characterize a true high-quality Tuscan extra virgin olive oil.
faq.q3: How long does the experience last and what does it include?
faq.a3: The experience lasts from 30 to 90 minutes. It includes an explanation of the continuous-cycle pressing process and technical tasting, often enriched by refined gastronomic pairings.
faq.q4: Is it possible to purchase oil at the end?
faq.a4: Certainly. You can buy our cold-pressed EVO oil directly from our farm shop. A perfect and exclusive souvenir of Arezzo's excellence.

header.subtitle: History
header.description: Founded in the 1960s in the Valdichiana region, the Del Pasqua company has evolved over the years by embracing diversification. We focus on product quality, innovation, and environmental sustainability, without ever losing sight of the values and flavors of authentic Tuscan and Italian traditions. This approach has opened new pathways in both olive growing and winemaking. Our entire production chain is local: from cultivating olive trees and grapevines to harvesting and packaging the final product.
header.description_top: Founded in the 1960s in the Valdichiana region, the Del Pasqua company has gradually shaped its identity around diversification, product quality, and innovation.
header.description_bottom: At the same time, it has remained faithful to environmental respect and to the values and flavors of true Tuscan and Italian tradition, opening new paths in both olive growing and winemaking. Our entire production chain stays rooted in our territory, from olive groves and vineyards to harvest and final packaging.

section1.subtitle: The olive groves
section1.p1: Our olive groves extend over 4 hectares, divided among the typical cultivars of the area.
section1.p2: While respecting traditional cultivation methods, we use modern and innovative techniques. The health of our newly planted olive trees is constantly monitored by our agronomist, who also assesses the ripeness of the olives.

section2.subtitle: The harvest
section2.p1: Harvesting takes place 'at the right moment' to obtain an oil rich in polyphenols, aromas, and taste. The olives are processed on the same day using cold extraction in our state-of-the-art olive mill.
section2.p2: Today, our products are suitable for every type of diet, serving a diverse market: appealing to everyone from connoisseurs of intense, fruity oils to those who prefer a lighter, more delicate flavor, as well as providing healthy nutrition for children during weaning.

philosophy.subtitle: Philosophy
philosophy.description: A family story, patient work, and constant care: quality is born from the sum of small gestures, repeated well, every year.

hero.label: Mill
hero.description: At the mill, every detail counts: from cleaning the olives to controlled malaxation, extraction, and storage. Here, technology and artisanal care work together to preserve freshness, aromas, and stability.

machines.label: Machines & Lines
machines.subtitle: Leaf removal, crushing, malaxation, extraction, and filtration: every stage is designed to preserve aromas and stability.

defogliazione.title: Leaf removal
defogliazione.desc: Removal of leaves and impurities, followed by a gentle wash.

frangitura.title: Crushing
frangitura.desc: Rapid crushing to minimize heating and oxidation.

gramolazione.title: Malaxation
gramolazione.desc: Slow mixing to combine micro-drops of oil.

estrazione.title: Extraction
estrazione.desc: Separation without thermal stress, monitored parameters.

separazione.title: Separation
separazione.desc: Refinement and clarification of the oil.

filtrazione.title: Filtration
filtrazione.desc: Stability over time and clean profile.

divider_1.label: CARE AND CONSERVATION
divider_1.text: Once extracted, we protect our oil from light and oxygen. Only this way do the mill's aromas arrive intact on your table.

divider_2.label: GUARANTEED QUALITY
divider_2.text: We leave nothing to chance: from the arrival of the olives to the checks on the final product.

trasporto.title: Cleanliness and stability
trasporto.text: Inside the mill, the oil moves only through stainless steel containers. Plastic is excluded because it can transfer off-flavors and compromise the product's clarity, aroma, and stability.

stoccaggio.title: Storage under nitrogen
stoccaggio.text: After extraction, the oil is stored in stainless steel tanks protected from light, temperature swings, and oxygen exposure. Nitrogen storage helps preserve aromas, freshness, and polyphenols until bottling.

imbottigliamento.title: Filling and packaging line
imbottigliamento.text: Our bottling line handles different formats, precise labeling, and orderly packaging while maintaining continuity and cleanliness throughout the final stage of the process.

controllo.title: Quality and traceability
controllo.text: Each batch is followed carefully from olive delivery to final packaging. Traceability, process checks, and verification on the finished oil help us keep the mill's quality consistent.

technology.label: The Mill
technology.description: In our mill, every phase is designed to protect aromas and polyphenols: rapid delivery, careful cleaning, cold extraction, and storage in controlled conditions.

steps_section.label: Production
steps_section.subtitle: Harvest, processing, and certifications: the stages that guide the quality of our extra virgin olive oil.

raccolta.title: Hand harvesting
paragraphs: Even today in Tuscany, the olive harvest is still done traditionally by hand. The freshly harvested olives are transported to the mill and processed within 12 hours to safeguard the integrity of their aromatic and phenolic components, using a modern Alfa Laval cold extraction system.

imbottigliamento.title: The bottling line
paragraphs: The plant is equipped with a line for bottling and packaging, and storage under nitrogen to guarantee the sensory qualities of the oil prior to bottling.
However, we don't stop there: we also offer custom milling and packaging services for third parties.

evo.title: Our EVO Oil
paragraphs: All these factors are an absolute guarantee for the production of extra virgin olive oil of the highest quality, capable of preserving the freshness and aromas that characterize freshly pressed oil for a longer period.

igp_bio.title: PGI AND ORGANIC
paragraphs: Our Italian extra virgin olive oil is not only produced from olives grown with respect for the environment, but all activities for its processing are subject to the strict controls of authorized certification bodies to guarantee the end consumer a natural, controlled, and certified product. The Del Pasqua mill is certified by Suolo e Salute for the processing and production of organic products and is registered with the Tuscan Olive Oil Consortium for the production of Toscano PGI extra virgin olive oil.

iqo.title: IQO Certification
iqo.text: Our extra virgin olive oil is IQO certified; chemical and scientific analyses guarantee a high natural nutritional value, long-term stability, and guaranteed traceability without risk of fraud.
